# Project guidelines

This file is a delegate for **JetBrains Junie**. The authoritative project guidance for all AI coding agents (Claude Code, Junie, Cursor, Copilot agents, etc.) lives in [`CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md) at the repository root.

**Do not edit this file.** Update `CLAUDE.md` — it is the single source of truth.

## TL;DR for Junie

- **Project:** kafka-scribe — Rust CLI for Kafka capture + deterministic replay + SQLite-backed queryable storage.
- **Task SSoT:** `kafka_scribe_task_list.md` (markdown-only mode; GitHub Issues deferred until post-v0.1.0).
- **Phase gating:** currently Phase 1 (MVP / v0.1.0 target). Avro, Protobuf, PostgreSQL, JS transforms, schema registry, plugin system, object storage are **Phase 2 — not started**.
- **Quality gates** before marking a task `COMPLETED`: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test`, acceptance criteria met, rustdoc on public APIs, task list updated.
- **Dead-code cleanup is active** (Week 1 of level-up): old first-gen `KafkaConsumer` in `src/kafka/consumer.rs` and the unreachable legacy body in `src/cli/commands/store.rs` are being removed. The cleaner, domain-oriented second implementation (`CoreKafkaConsumer` + `RdKafkaConsumer` currently in `src/core/store_usecase.rs`) is the keep.

Read `CLAUDE.md` for architecture, ADRs, task-selection protocol, security baseline, and the full 10-week level-up sequence.
